paper_description: Proposed the famous program repair tool Angelix, successfully deeply integrating symbolic execution and program synthesis, and for the first time elevating semantic-based program defect repair to a practical level, making it one of the three mainstream technical approaches for defect repair.
The doctoral dissertation received the 'ACM SIGSOFT Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Award' in 2019.
Subsequent work continuously advanced the capabilities of defect repair technology and the industrial deployment of program repair.
Related work also received several ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Awards.
